The war caused the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] to relinquish control over Paven Prime and withdraw from [[Realspace/Legends|space]] controlled by the [[Gu-vandi]] species.<ref name="KOTOR2">''[[Star Wars: Knights of the Old Republic II: The Sith Lords]]''</ref>
